issues.title: Phase 0 — Skeleton
issues.body:
**Status.** Delivered through PR #1.

**Work.** Go module `github.com/djm56/cairn-memory`, Go 1.25. `cmd/cairn` with the sub-command frame and `cairn version`. Makefile (`build`, `test`, `vet`, `fmt`, `run`). CI on pull requests: `go vet`, `go test -race`, `gofmt` check. MIT licence (as bishop-memory). `CONTRIBUTING.md` with the rules in §6. `.gitignore` for `bin/`, `dist/`, `*.db`.

**Exit check.** `make test` passes in CI on an empty suite; `bin/cairn version` prints a version from `git describe`.

issues.title: Phase 1 — Contract
issues.body:
**Status.** Built through PR #2; the exit check is open until the operator's review of CONTRACT.md §9.

**Work.** `internal/core`: the `Service` interface, the request and result types for every tool in DESIGN.md §4, and the error kinds (not found, refused by policy, invalid, operator only). `docs/CONTRACT.md`: each tool's inputs, outputs, errors and an example. `internal/conformance`: a test suite that takes any `Service` and checks the behaviour, including: a whole task (start with a brief and plan, step through it, log events, record a review, add a learning, be refused at close with the missing items listed, close); inserting a step between two others without renumbering; refusing every write without a project; refusing every operator-only change through the agent interface; events are append-only and timestamps are the server's; `task_current` returns the one active task, and nothing when none is. The suite cannot pass yet; it runs against a stub that fails every call.

**Exit check.** `CONTRACT.md` covers every tool in DESIGN.md §4. The conformance suite compiles and reports every case as failing against the stub. Review of the contract by the operator before phase 2 starts.

issues.title: Phase 2 — Core and local store
issues.body:
**Work.** `internal/store`: schema v1 (DESIGN.md §3) as numbered migrations, WAL mode, busy timeout, FTS5 index and its triggers. Typed query functions for every table. `internal/core`: the `Service` implementation over the store, holding every rule: status transitions, the close policy, step positions, task-id allocation in one transaction, operator-only changes. `internal/identity`: project resolution from `CAIRN_PROJECT` and `.cairn.toml` (DESIGN.md §2.1).

**Exit check.** The conformance suite passes against the local `Service`. Two processes writing the same database at once allocate distinct task ids (a test). `go test -race` is clean.

**Port from.** Port from bishop-memory: `internal/store/sqlite.go` and `migrate.go`, the FTS setup from `db/schema.sql`, and the allocator's daily sequence from `internal/api/allocate.go`.

issues.body:

Ported from bishop-memory's mission HUD. **Learnings**: proposed findings with accept, reject and supersede, each with a note. **Exit check.** The operator can run the whole learning loop from the browser: see a proposed finding, accept it, ratify it as a directive, and see it returned by `directive_list` and `task_current` in the next session.

A scheduling guide for launchd and systemd.
